proposals.title: Review proposals
proposals.intro: Every proposal members have sent, waiting on your decision. Rejecting and requesting changes each need a written reason, which reaches the proposer.
proposals.empty: No proposals are waiting for review.
proposals.count: {count, plural, =0 {no proposals} one {one proposal} other {{value} proposals}}
proposals.age: {count, plural, =0 {arrived today} one {a day ago} other {{value} days ago}}
proposals.notesLabel: The proposer's notes for the admin
proposals.approveNote: Approving does not publish the session — scheduling and publishing are a separate act.
proposals.reasonLabel: The reason the proposer will read
proposals.reasonHint: Write it the way you would say it to them — it is all they will see of your decision.
proposals.reasonRequired: Write the reason first — no decision reaches a proposer without one.
proposals.failed: That decision could not be recorded — try again.
proposals.done: Your decision is recorded and has reached the proposer.
